eyebrow: A LOOK AT FIRE THROUGH TIME
title: Is fire activity in this area outside its usual pattern?
intro: Explore time, recognize patterns and make room to prepare. A calendar to understand fire activity, month by month.
methodLink: How are MODIS and VIIRS harmonized?
select: Select a month to explore the example.
detailNote: Fictional demonstration data. Synthetic visual pattern, without a physical unit, sensor or satellite acquisition. This is not a harmonized index or a validated historical comparison.
step1Text: The calendar will bring years and months together to explore an area's history.
step2Text: MODIS and VIIRS require harmonization before their records can be compared.
step3Text: Future phases will introduce zones, prevention and verifiable alerts.
placeholder: This phase prepares navigation. Maps, authentication, official resources and operational features will be integrated in their respective tasks.

warning: A satellite detection is not a confirmed fire.
attribution: Planned integration source: NASA FIRMS (LANCE / EOSDIS). This demonstration contains no NASA data.
footer: A tool to observe with context and act with care.

methodText: The proposed method will bring MODIS and VIIRS S-NPP to a common unit. Calibration and scientific validation are pending; this grid only demonstrates the interface.

sectionIntros.mapa: Explore the map and the area's synthetic calendar. Adjust the years, select a month and play back the demonstration day by day.
sectionIntros.actualidad: Synthetic view of recent detections. Review the card, sensor and time; no detection is a confirmed fire.
sectionIntros.prevencion: Organize preparation by month and review resources. This demonstration does not load official organizations or protocols.
sectionIntros.laboratorio: Sensor comparison is pending integration. No scientific results are presented.
sectionIntros.zonas: Private zone management requires authentication and is not connected yet.
sectionIntros.respuesta: Operational response requires a coordinator role and verified data; it is not connected.
